title: Romancero gitano
author: Federico García Lorca
note: Primer romancero gitano (1928): 18 romances, each numbered on a line of its own, then a half-title page with its dedication, then the title again and the poem. The number lines are the headings; each poem's half-title block (up to the gap of 4+ blank lines) is dropped, and so are lines in capitals (its repeated title, section labels such as PRIMERA LAGUNA) and roman-numeral part numbers. Ends at the index.
chapters: Prendimiento de Antoñito el Camborio en el camino de Sevilla
Romance de la guardia civil española
Burla de don Pedro a caballo
